current_task_corrections.correction: Add 'network_status' as a standalone grouping dimension in group_comparison to enable separate analysis of in-network and out-of-network provider performance metrics.
Update group_by parameter in group_comparison to include all three dimensions: ['provider_specialty', 'network_status', 'provider_specialty+network_status'].
Include 'network_status' as a grouping dimension so that denial rates can be computed separately for in-network and out-of-network claims using adjudicated claims as the denominator.
